about.p1: I’m a software engineer working across application architecture, full-stack development and data processing. I work with business teams to understand what they need, design a suitable solution and take it through development and deployment, with ongoing maintenance and improvements.
about.p2: I’ve worked in energy, healthcare, mining, rail and research, in France and the UK. Each setting brings different constraints. I start with the need before choosing technologies, explain the reasoning behind architectural decisions and favour code that a team can maintain and extend without unnecessary complexity.
about.p3: My PhD in mechanics and numerical modelling informs how I work: breaking down problems, questioning assumptions and checking results. These habits help me assess technical options against the way the software will be used and the constraints of the project.

services.meta_desc: Software architecture, full-stack development, data engineering, AI integration and deployment for business applications.
services.intro: I work from initial requirements through to deployment, covering architecture, full-stack development, data and integration. I can build an application, investigate a technical issue or support your team as the project develops.
services.svc_1_p: You need a new business application, or changes to software that has become difficult to maintain.
services.svc_1_d: I design the architecture and build interfaces, APIs and business logic. My tools include Vue.js, Python and TypeScript/Node.js, with tests and documentation to help your team maintain the application.
services.svc_2_p: Your data comes from several systems, in different formats and with varying levels of quality.
services.svc_2_d: I design data models and processes for collecting, transforming and checking data. The aim is to make it usable by your applications and keep the processing traceable over time.
services.svc_3_p: You want to integrate an AI model into an application and assess its value in everyday use.
services.svc_3_d: I define the use case, data requirements and evaluation criteria. I then integrate the model into the application, accounting for its limitations and the demands of running it in production.
services.svc_4_p: Slow responses, recurring incidents or operating costs are holding your application back, with no clear explanation.
services.svc_4_d: I examine the architecture, data access and processing to identify bottlenecks. I recommend actions based on their expected impact and the practical constraints of implementing them.
services.svc_5_p: Your application needs to evolve, but its architecture or deployment process makes changes difficult.
services.svc_5_d: I plan incremental improvements, including containerisation, automated deployments and checks before release. Each step accounts for the existing system and its operational requirements.
services.svc_6_p: You need to clarify a technical requirement, compare architectures or explore an unproven approach.
services.svc_6_d: I analyse the problem, compare options and test assumptions through focused experiments. I document the trade-offs so you can make decisions with a clear understanding of the constraints and remaining questions.

research.meta_desc: Research by Hamed Bouare: a doctoral thesis, journal article and conference papers on wave propagation and the dynamic response of underground structures.
research.lead: Research into how underground structures respond to mechanical waves.
research.intro_1: My PhD examined how tunnels and cavities respond to mechanical waves, including seismic waves. I developed models and computational methods to study stresses and displacements in these structures and the surrounding ground.
research.intro_2: The work brings together continuum mechanics, wave propagation, mathematical modelling and numerical methods. It strengthened habits I continue to use in software engineering: stating assumptions, choosing an appropriate method and checking which conclusions the results support.
research.stat_pubs: 5 works: article, thesis and conference papers
research.impact_lead: Research taught me to work through open questions while keeping clear criteria for checking the results. These habits help me design software and explain the reasoning behind technical decisions.
research.impact_1_d: Break a question down, identify what is unknown and define what needs to be solved.
research.impact_2_d: Represent the relevant parts of a problem and state the limits of the model.
research.impact_3_d: Compare computational cost, accuracy and convergence when choosing a method.
research.impact_4_d: Make assumptions explicit and calculations reproducible and verifiable.
research.impact_5_d: Structure data, check its quality and interpret the results.
research.impact_6_d: Compare calculations with measurements, examining discrepancies and uncertainties.
research.impact_7_d: Explain methods and results to people from different disciplines.
research.impact_8_d: Organise independent work, document progress and carry analyses through to completion.
